overall_notes: Offer submitted as a prose Word letter (Ref DCB/NHPC/2026/88 dated 21st September 2026) with no priced schedule; all prices were extracted from narrative paragraphs P9-P13. Vendor used RFx item numbers 1-30 which map 1:1 to RFx lines L01-L30. Prices delivered to Bhiwandi, excluding GST @ 18% - matches buyer's requested basis. Key deviations: (a) 60-day payment vs 45 requested; (b) price-variation clause after 180 days tied to kraft paper index if movement exceeds 6%; (c) items 11, 12, 30 (7-ply boxes and bulk bin) declined - outside machine capability, 7-ply line expected Q2 FY28; (d) ISO 9001:2015 certificate claimed (No. TQC/IN/QMS/14-20931, valid to Nov 2027) but NO COPY ATTACHED despite RFx requiring attachment - Q01 evaluation evidence incomplete; (e) Q11 customer names not disclosed. L10 priced only by cross-reference to item 6 BF 22 rate (Rs. 31.80) - no independent figure given. L06 has an alternate BF 20 offer at Rs. 30.35 which is a spec deviation (bursting strength 16.3 vs spec >= 17.6 per their own test report). Only enclosure is the vendor's own in-house BCT test report; no third-party test certificate, no GST certificate. Free plates/dies apply only to the first artwork of each item - repeat/changed artwork charges unquantified.
